operation.raw_query: SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS bucket, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z' AND created_at < '2026-04-02T00:00:00Z' AND status = 'paid' GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('hour', created_at) ORDER BY bucket
